title: I don't think AI will make your processes go faster
summary: A critical perspective questioning the widely held belief that AI will automatically speed up business processes. The author challenges the current hype around AI-driven productivity gains, suggesting that simply integrating AI doesn't guarantee process optimization or time savings.
problem_solved: Challenges the misconception that AI adoption automatically leads to faster, more efficient processes.
why_valuable: Provides a much-needed critical counterbalance to the prevalent AI hype, encouraging more realistic expectations about AI's actual impact on productivity.
